data.name: Fury
data.description: A shaman incites a creature within 30 feet into a primal fury. The target receives a +%1 morale bonus on attack rolls and a +%1 resistance bonus on saving throws against fear for %2 rounds. Once a creature has benefited from the fury hex, it cannot benefit from it again for 24 hours.|ShamanFuryHexBonus|ShamanFuryHexDuration
